{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = "/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv"
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Clean the 'revenue' column: remove commas and convert to float
data['revenue_clean'] = data['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Identify QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_mask = data['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99
num_qa_orders = qa_mask.sum()
print(f"Number of QA orders: {num_qa_orders}")

# Filter out QA orders
data_clean = data[~qa_mask]

# Identify refunded orders
refunded_mask = data_clean['status'] == 'refunded'
num_refunded = refunded_mask.sum()
print(f"Number of refunded orders: {num_refunded}")

# Filter to the population: new + paid_search + completed
population = ((data_clean['customer_segment'] == 'new') & 
              (data_clean['channel'] == 'paid_search') & 
              (data_clean['status'] == 'completed'))

filtered_data = data_clean[population]

# Compute the fraction converted
converted_count = filtered_data['converted'].sum()
total_count = len(filtered_data)

fraction_converted = converted_count / total_count

print(f"Converted count: {converted_count}")
print(f"Total count: {total_count}")
print(f"Fraction converted: {fraction_converted}")

# Return the result
fraction_converted"}
